Hosting & Maintenance

Managed hosting, backups, updates and monitoring for your sites and apps.

See it in action

  • Visitors are served from the nearest edge location
  • Nightly backup snapshot is stored off the server
  • Origin fails: traffic fails over to the standby automatically
  • Updates applied, verified and monitored

Illustrative simulation of a typical scenario. Not live customer data.

How it works, step by step in 3D

  1. Serve Visitors are served from the nearest edge, with the origin server behind it.
  2. Back up The site and its data are copied on a schedule, and restores are tested.
  3. Monitor Uptime, speed and certificates are watched and problems raise an alert.
  4. Maintain Updates and security patches are applied on a planned schedule.

Illustrative flow of a typical setup. Not live customer data. Drag to look around, or use the step buttons.
